items.title: From polycrisis to polysolutions
items.text: Complex development challenges demand integrated solutions. IP3 connects expertise across eight sectors to turn interconnected problems into practical action.

items.title: Translation, not theory
items.text: From evidence to implementation, IP3 develops actionable policies, investment-ready projects, institutional reforms, and results-driven solutions that translate development ambitions into measurable outcomes.

items.title: Research that changes decisions
items.text: Thinking that ships — IP3 connects rigorous research, data-driven insights, and applied analysis with real-world development challenges, generating actionable evidence, decision-ready diagnostics, business cases and evaluations to inform policies, investments, and institutional reforms — not publications for their own sake.

items.title: A convenor between worlds
items.text: Structured policy dialogue, investment forums and technical working groups that align governments, capital and implementers.
